what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Tunisia in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6182 Tunisian asylum seekers in Italy, 59.8% of all asylum seekers from Tunisia.
Refugees from Tunisia, a separate group, live mostly in France, Italy, Germany and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Tunisia from 2013 to 2015, and with the Islamic State group in 2016.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2023 to 2025, come later than those conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 31 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 6219, at the end of 2024.
It was slightly lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
